title: ListViewChart - Data API
description: Represents a graphical chart that’s displayed on Salesforce for Android, iOS, and mobile web list views. The chart aggregates data that is filtered based on the list view that’s currently displayed. This object is available in API version 33.0 and later and is accessible by portal users.

AggregateField.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Query, Restricted picklist, Retrieve, Sort, Update
AggregateField.description: The field that’s used for calculating data on each group. AggregateField can’t be the same as GroupingField.

AggregateType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Query, Restricted picklist, Retrieve, Sort, Update
AggregateType.description: The type of calculations to run on each group. The supported AggregateType values are Count, Sum, and Avg.

ChartType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Query, Restricted picklist,Retrieve, Sort, Update
ChartType.description: The type of chart to create. The supported chart types are horizontal bar chart, vertical bar chart, and donut chart.

DeveloperName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Query, Retrieve, Sort, Update
DeveloperName.description: The fully qualified developer name of the chart. Note: Only users with View DeveloperName OR View Setup and Configuration permission can view, group, sort, and filter this field.

GroupingField.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Query, Restricted picklist, Retrieve, Sort, Update
GroupingField.description: The field that’s used to divide the data into collections. The field must be supported by SOQL GROUP BY functionality. GroupingField can’t be the same as AggregateField.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update

MasterLabel.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Query, Retrieve, Sort, Update

OwnerId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Query, Retrieve, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the user who owns the chart. This is a relationship field. Relationship Name Owner Relationship Type Lookup Refers To User

SobjectType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Query, Restricted picklist, Retrieve, Sort
SobjectType.description: The API name of the sObject for the chart.
